name: Monika Santra
title: PhD Candidate, Computer Science & Engineering · Penn State
tagline: Software & systems security researcher — binary analysis, program analysis, and AI/ML for security.
research_intro: My PhD research is on AI-assisted, or neurosymbolic, program analysis — combining machine learning with traditional static analysis for binary reverse engineering. It grew out of five years as a Research Scientist at BARC, where hands-on systems-security work made me want better tools for understanding compiled code at scale.
